purpose: Every test must have one deliberate release disposition. Rules are ordered; the first match wins.

rules.reason: Checks native migration boundaries and complete UX audit coverage; structural only, never installed-device acceptance.
Kotlin profile, source, persistence and onboarding invariants; execution requires the native Gradle test dependencies.
Dependency-free Kotlin executable validates the core locally with cached compiler tooling, not UI, models or hardware.
Setup, Home, Settings, provider, and device-install evidence must be current, source-fingerprinted, narrowly attributed, and must not manufacture security, visual, or hardware review.
A source-fingerprinted browser journey must observe Home shelves, persist profile motion and density through the server and reload, and expose honest Help/status state.
Day-0 Family, child exit, Kids Present, filtering, Companion truth, and Watch Together host/join/reconnect journeys must pass against a fresh isolated service with source-fingerprinted evidence.
Paired Android update discovery must report only an existing APK, bind the same-origin download to its SHA-256, serve identical bytes, and reject stale or traversal-shaped paths.
Day-0 trust bootstrap, signed manifests, and anti-replay fail closed.
Signed artifact staging, health-gated activation, and rollback fail closed.
Recovery remains checksummed, allowlisted, confirmed, and credential-free.
Packaged update entry points cannot bypass signed apply.
Family treatment must bind to one verified edition and timebase, validate deterministic intervals, and fail closed when evidence is absent or mismatched.
The browser executor must deterministically skip or hide visuals, mute unsafe audio, and hide or replace subtitles only inside verified intervals.
Web players must publish real session timing and consume only bounded commands addressed to their active session.
Household matching must preserve objections and remote invites may render only server-confirmed rooms and participants.
Legacy companion links may restore only validated episode context that the authenticated profile can already access; malformed, unavailable, and child-ineligible targets fail closed.
Every release packager must share the same allowlist, manifest, secret scan, retired-stack exclusion, and verification boundary.
Native personal, public-domain, prepared, and authorized provider sources must project honestly into playback without inventing readiness.
Legal external availability must remain regional, attributed, bounded, and quietly unavailable when it cannot be verified.
Connected specialists must retain deterministic safety fallbacks and cannot gain access, destructive, or playback authority.
The taste field must replenish continuously, preserve distinct reversible reactions, and avoid forced pagination or completion.
Client availability parsing must preserve honest unavailable states and official attributed destinations.
Optional local-model downloads must remain pinned, integrity-checked, external to the repository, and non-activating.
Preparation must use bounded authenticated requests and verified originals, never client paths or invented availability.
Retention acknowledgements require a durable private pin on the authorized server-resolved local original; unpin never deletes media.
Repeated first pages and stale query responses cannot erase or replace the current discovery results.
Every legacy taste entry point must expose accessible recovery without replaying unacknowledged reactions.
Legacy curator URLs must preserve profile privacy and cannot mutate household-global taste.
Automatic cleanup cannot scan or delete originals without an authoritative managed-retention ledger.
Development and preview must enforce the same playback-byte authority as the household server.
Fresh-session context must remain accurate and compact.
The runtime registry, coordinator wiring, lifecycle metadata, fallbacks, privacy boundaries, evidence, and retired architecture must remain reconciled.
Feature, vision, and test accountability is a release invariant.
Release acceptance must stay blocked until current evidence exists for every active feature and interface requirement.
The release gate must execute its intended classified contract set.
The cross-home gossip prototype is excluded from the shipping private intelligence runtime.
The fleet-learning prototype is excluded; household learning remains local.
The peer gossip lighthouse is not part of the native shipping control plane.
ReelOS ships only the Jellyfin protocol shim, not a managed Jellyfin server.
The deterministic cinema-brain prototype is archived compatibility, not a trained shipping model.
Resource safety now belongs to the shared governor; the old scale engine is retained only for migration coverage.
The distillation prototype cannot ship until it is registered with the guarded model lifecycle.
The old simulation imports retired engines; current release evidence comes from resource-governor and preparation tests.
Core server, source, safety, and resource contracts.
Consumer state, search, taste, and source-access contracts.
Local browser availability varies; required before an install candidate when the browser matrix is enabled.
Appliance packaging and install contracts are exercised for household candidates.
Update and rollback contracts are exercised for household candidates.
USB creation and recovery contracts are exercised for household candidates.
Platform-specific packaging contracts are exercised for the matching install target.
Retained while its route or service is reconciled; cannot be silently deleted or ignored.
